mapper.select: SELECT EXTERNAL_API_ID, API_NAME, API_URL, HTTP_METHOD, ENABLED, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API ORDER BY EXTERNAL_API_ID DESC
SELECT EXTERNAL_API_ID, API_NAME, API_URL, HTTP_METHOD, ENABLED, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API WHERE EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId}

SELECT PARAM_ID, EXTERNAL_API_ID, PARAM_LOCATION, PARAM_NAME, VALUE_TYPE, PARAM_VALUE, VALUE_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER, DESCRIPTION FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_PARAM WHERE EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, PARAM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_EXTERNAL_API ( API_NAME, API_URL, HTTP_METHOD, ENABLED, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{apiName}, #{apiUrl}, #{httpMethod}, #{enabled}, #{description}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_PARAM ( EXTERNAL_API_ID, PARAM_LOCATION, PARAM_NAME, VALUE_TYPE, PARAM_VALUE, VALUE_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{externalApiId}, #{paramLocation}, #{paramName}, #{valueType}, #{paramValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{valueFormat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requiredYn}, #{sortOrder}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHED_EXTERNAL_API SET API_NAME = #{apiName}, API_URL = #{apiUrl}, HTTP_METHOD = #{httpMethod}, ENABLED = #{enabled}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId}
